0839ad89d79403e8.description: About Globant Globant is dedicated to enhancing business development and enterprise solutions to prepare them for a digital future. With a diverse team across more than 30 countries, Globant serves as a strategic partner to leading global companies in their business process transformation initiatives. Role Overview Globant is seeking a Senior Operations Specialist to lead commercial health, client billing governance, and delivery operations for technology and IT consulting accounts based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a contract position requiring 5-10 years of experience. The role reports directly to the Operations Director and involves bridging delivery teams with client commercial stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Manage the monthly billing cycle end-to-end, including validating consultant timesheets and delivery milestones. Track client purchase order (PO) consumption and resolve invoicing disputes to reduce Days Sales Outstanding (DSO). Oversee and defend contract mechanisms for Time & Materials, Fixed Capacity, and Managed Services structures. Coordinate change requests (CRs), scope extensions, and commercial rate card renewals. Partner with account delivery leads to monitor project actuals against forecasts. Track account gross margins, billable utilization, and resource pyramid/location mix. Develop operational and financial dashboards using Advanced Excel and Power BI. Integrate modern AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to streamline recurring operational reporting workflows. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in operations, commercial health, or billing governance. Demonstrated ability to manage end-to-end billing cycles and invoice collections. Experience with contract governance and margin optimization. Proficiency in Advanced Excel and Power BI for operational and financial reporting. Familiarity with AI tools for process automation is beneficial. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Equal Opportunity Employer Globant is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Globant is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If assistance or accommodation is needed due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

0843390fc6973954.description: About Ma'aden Ma'aden, a leading mining company, is seeking a Manager Project Base Metals Projects to join its team. This full-time position is based in the Khurais oil field, Saudi Arabia, and requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in project management. Role Overview The Manager, PBM Projects will be responsible for leading and managing all Base Metals (PBM) activities related to exploration projects within the Western Region. This role ensures that all initiatives align with strategic goals, budget constraints, and established timelines. The Manager will oversee the comprehensive planning, execution, and performance monitoring of these exploration projects, working closely with various technical and business teams to achieve project success. Key Responsibilities Manage the portfolio of exploration projects in the Western Region, from initial planning stages through to execution. Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, and resource allocation plans. Monitor project performance and implement corrective actions as necessary to ensure objectives are met. Ensure strict compliance with internal governance frameworks, safety protocols, and environmental standards. Collaborate effectively with geoscience, finance, procurement, and operations teams to facilitate project delivery. Prepare and present regular project updates and comprehensive reports to senior leadership. Support risk management processes and change control procedures for all projects. Mentor project coordinators and contribute to the overall capability development within the PBM department. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in project management, specifically within the base metals or exploration sector. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage complex exploration projects. Strong understanding of project planning, budgeting, and resource management. Experience in monitoring project performance and implementing corrective actions. Familiarity with governance, safety, and environmental compliance standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in the Khurais oil field, Saudi Arabia, offering a dynamic environment within Ma'aden's exploration division.

08b69d03d1984eec.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركه منبع التصافي عن مشرف تنظيف وتدبير للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على أنشطة التدبير في المرافق التجارية وتنسيقها وتنفيذها، لضمان الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب المرافق. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الجدول الزمني للخدمات وتنسيقه بفعالية. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية الخاصة بأعمال الموظفين وتحضيرها. الإشراف المباشر على الموظفين أثناء أدائهم لواجبات التنظيف، بما في ذلك مسح الأتربة، كنس الأرضيات، تنظيف دورات المياه، وتغيير الشراشف. ضمان تنفيذ سياسات وإجراءات التدبير المنزلي المعتمدة. مراقبة مخزون إمدادات التنظيف والمعدات والإمدادات الأخرى والحفاظ عليه. اتباع وتطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الإشراف على خدمات التنظيف والتدبير أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إدارة وتنسيق فرق العمل بفعالية. معرفة جيدة بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التفرغ الكامل. سيعمل المشرف ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان أعلى معايير النظافة والترتيب في المرافق التجارية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركه منبع التصافي.

08c73fdf9e419e39.description: About Alwedad Charity Alwedad Charity is dedicated to the care of orphans. We are seeking a Services and Partnerships Management Director to join our team in Makkah and Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for a professional with 5-10 years of experience in institutional relations, partnerships, or business development. Role Overview The Services and Partnerships Management Director will be responsible for developing and executing strategies for relationships and partnerships that align with the charity's objectives. This role involves building and maintaining relationships with various governmental, private, and non-profit entities, as well as overseeing partnership agreements and team performance. Key Responsibilities Prepare and implement a relations and partnerships plan in line with the charity's goals. Build and manage relationships with governmental, private, and non-profit organizations. Explore partnership opportunities and oversee negotiations and agreement preparation. Represent the charity in relevant meetings and events. Monitor the implementation of partnerships, measure their results, and prepare reports. Supervise the relations and partnerships team and enhance their performance. Manage and regularly update the partners' database. Enhance the institutional image and build relationships that support the achievement of the entity's objectives. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Public Relations, Marketing, or an equivalent field. A minimum of 5 years of experience in institutional relations, partnerships, or business development. Supervisory or leadership experience is preferred. Demonstrated experience in building partnerships, managing negotiations, and fostering institutional relationships. Work Location This full-time position is based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this role to contribute to our mission of caring for orphans.

08ca48c7589e76f2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الرأي للخدمات البيئية عن فني مكافحة آفات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إزالة الكائنات غير المرغوب فيها مثل الحشرات الضارة، الحيوانات الصغيرة، أو النباتات البرية، لضمان بيئة آمنة وصحية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال مكافحة الآفات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفتيش المناطق أو النباتات المصابة لتحديد الآفات المطلوب إزالتها. تحديد نوع العلاج المناسب وتقدير المتطلبات والتكاليف المرتبطة به. تحضير منطقة المعالجة والمواد المستخدمة، وإزالة أي عوائق قد تعترض عملية الرش. نشر التحذيرات اللازمة والتحضير لعمليات التعقيم بالتبخير. خلط المواد الكيميائية بدقة وفقاً لاحتياجات معالجة الآفات المحددة. وضع أو رش المحاليل الكيميائية أو الغازات السامة. التحقق من نتائج المعالجة وتكرار الإجراءات إذا لزم الأمر لضمان الفعالية. الالتزام الصارم بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال مكافحة الآفات. القدرة على تحديد أنواع الآفات المختلفة وتطبيق العلاجات المناسبة. معرفة جيدة بالمواد الكيميائية المستخدمة في مكافحة الآفات وطرق خلطها الآمنة. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية والبيئية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني مكافحة الآفات ضمن فريق شركة الرأي للخدمات البيئية في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب العمل في مواقع مختلفة حسب الحاجة لإزالة الآفات. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقديم على هذا الدور.

0864412bf275bbdc.job_title: HSSE Manager Al Futtaim Automotive BYD
0864412bf275bbdc.description: About the Role: HSSE Manager Al Futtaim Group is seeking an HSSE Manager to lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Health, Safety, Security, and Environment programs for Al-Futtaim Automotive – BYD operations across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam, and requires 6-10 years of experience, with salary not disclosed. The HSSE Manager will ensure full compliance with KSA regulatory frameworks and align operational practices with Al-Futtaim Group HSSE governance standards, reporting to the Head of Government Relations & HSSE. Role Purpose and Scope The position holds direct accountability for protecting the workforce, customers, assets, and brand reputation across BYD showrooms, workshops, parts warehouses, and corporate sites in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and the wider KSA dealer network. This role is critical for enabling business growth by ensuring uninterrupted operations, securing all statutory certifications, and embedding a strong safety-first culture across the BYD KSA footprint. Key Responsibilities Drive hazard identification and gap reporting across all assigned BYD KSA sites through scheduled inspections, risk assessments, and field walkthroughs. Reduce preventable incidents through structured corrective and preventive action plans, tracking all findings to closure. Conduct full-cycle incident investigations for medium and high-severity events within 24 hours, documenting root-cause analysis. Maintain the Automotive Risk Register with up-to-date hazard observations, control measures, and residual risk ratings. Achieve and sustain a minimum 80% compliance score across all HSSE Compliance Audits for assigned sites. Ensure full alignment with KSA HSSE legislation, including Saudi Civil Defense, MHRSD, HCIS, SASO, and Environmental requirements. Secure and renew all statutory permits, including Civil Defense Safety Certificates, Environmental Clearance, and Municipal HSSE clearances. Stay current with KSA regulatory developments and proactively implement operational adjustments. Ensure zero notices of violation across all assigned sites and no pending high-risk audit recommendations beyond 90 days. Represent Al-Futtaim Automotive – BYD in regulatory inspections, OEM HSSE audits, and third-party assessments. Develop and maintain site-specific emergency response plans and supervise a minimum of two emergency evacuation drills per site per year. Ensure all sites comply with Civil Defense requirements for trained First Aiders and Fire Wardens. Maintain full operational readiness of fire alarm, suppression, and life-safety systems. Lead the HSSE response for major business events, product launches, and customer activations. Lead structured monthly Safety Committee meetings at every assigned site. Embed visible safety standards across all facilities, including signage, PPE compliance, and LOTO procedures. Champion continuous workforce awareness through toolbox talks, safety alerts, and structured campaigns. Develop and maintain Safe Work Procedures (SWPs) for all hazardous tasks, machinery, and operations. Lead BYD KSA operations through ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and other relevant international certifications. Maintain documented HSSE management systems aligned with Al-Futtaim Group standards and international benchmarks. Coordinate with internal compliance teams and external certification bodies for successful audits. Drive continuous improvement of HSSE policies, procedures, and standard operating practices. Lead, develop, and supervise HSSE Officers and the field HSSE team across the BYD KSA dealer network. Set clear performance objectives, conduct monthly performance reviews, and manage gaps through improvement frameworks. Build technical capability across the team through structured training and certification pathways. Maintain audit-ready records of team coverage, site visit frequency, and operational deployment. Drive Saudization of the HSSE function in line with MHRSD requirements. Deliver regular HSSE performance dashboards, audit summaries, and incident trend analysis to senior leadership. Partner with Aftersales, Sales, Logistics, Facilities, HR, and Government Relations leadership to integrate HSSE priorities. Provide executive-level visibility on HSSE risk exposure, mitigation progress, and statutory certification status. Support business strategy reviews with credible HSSE intelligence on regulatory shifts and operational risk. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Sciences, or a related discipline. Certifications: NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC) is mandatory; NEBOSH International Diploma is strongly preferred. IOSH Managing Safely certification is mandatory. ISO 45001 / ISO 14001 Lead Auditor, OSHA 30, or NFPA equivalents are highly preferred. Experience: Minimum 6 to 12 years of progressive HSSE experience, including at least 3 to 5 years in a managerial capacity. Industry Exposure: Demonstrable experience in automotive retail, dealer operations, large-scale workshops, parts/logistics warehousing, or comparable multi-site industries. Regulatory Knowledge: Direct working exposure to KSA regulatory frameworks, including Saudi Civil Defense, MHRSD, HCIS (where applicable), SASO, and Environmental Authorities. Audit Experience: Proven track record of leading ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certification and surveillance audits to successful outcomes. Technical Skills: Strong working knowledge of HSSE management systems, incident reporting platforms, and analytics tools. Mobility: Valid KSA driving license and willingness to travel across all KSA regions on a regular basis, including weekends when required. Work Environment This is a full-time position within Al Futtaim Group's automotive division, specifically supporting BYD operations across multiple sites in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam. The role involves regular travel within KSA to ensure compliance and operational readiness across the dealer network.

084657a259058e3a.job_title: Allocator (Merchandise Planner) The Visitor Head office
084657a259058e3a.description: About Chalhoub Group Chalhoub Group has operated as a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East for over seven decades. The Group manages a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and provides distribution and marketing expertise for more than 400 international brands across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories. With over 16,000 professionals across eight countries in the Middle East and a presence in LATAM, Chalhoub Group is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and aims to reach Net Zero by 2040. Role Summary Chalhoub Group is seeking an Allocator (Merchandise Planner) to join its team in Jeddah or Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the optimal distribution of inventory and maintaining product availability across retail, e-commerce, and B2B channels. The Allocator will be responsible for inventory planning, replenishment, and monitoring key performance indicators to support efficient supply chain operations. Key Responsibilities Define and execute initial allocation strategies for seasonal products across stores, aligning with assortment and demand plans. Develop and maintain inventory and replenishment plans, considering store space, delivery frequency, and stock requirements. Implement allocation strategies by adapting stock parameters, safety stock, and days of coverage to optimize inventory levels and prevent overstock or stockouts. Manage inventory push initiatives in alignment with sales and clearance strategies, including markdown and promotional activities. Track and initiate inventory balance between stores, MFC (Digital), and the hub to manage In-Stock Availability (ISA) across all networks. Optimize store-to-store stock transfers to balance inventory levels and meet dynamic demand and ISA. Collaborate with retail teams to coordinate upcoming delivery volumes and ensure operational readiness at the store level. Conduct regular store visits with the team. KPI Monitoring Track and analyze planning KPIs, including In-Stock Availability (ISA), Days of Inventory (DOI), and On-Time In-Full (OTIF), to identify and resolve inefficiencies. Track and analyze store-to-store transfers. Required Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Application Process Chalhoub Group is committed to inclusion and diversity, welcoming all applicants regardless of gender, age, race, religion, national origin, or disability status. Candidates are requested to complete assessments and interviews independently, without assistance from generative AI tools, to ensure an accurate evaluation of individual strengths and problem-solving approaches.

087f8b944329fa02.description: About the Role Nahdi Medical Co. is seeking a Corporate Applications Senior Department Manager to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on managing and overseeing all aspects of corporate applications, including those related to HR, finance, and procurement. The position involves assessing new tools, aligning initiatives with business strategies, driving implementation, and maintaining operational standards and performance metrics. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement strategies for the effective acquisition, implementation, and use of corporate applications such as HR systems, financial software, and procurement tools. Collaborate with IT and business leaders to align application strategies with overall business goals, particularly with end-user leaders and applications department management. Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of corporate application projects, ensuring timely completion, adherence to budget, and quality standards, while managing project risks. Lead the development, customization, and enhancement of corporate applications, and oversee the maintenance and support of existing applications to ensure reliability, performance, and compliance with IT standards and regulatory requirements. Manage and develop the corporate applications team, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages innovation. Work closely with stakeholders to understand their needs and challenges, communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical parties regarding application capabilities and limitations. Manage relationships with software vendors and service providers, negotiating contracts to ensure optimal value and service for the organization. Stay informed of emerging technology trends and best practices in corporate applications, recommending and driving the implementation of new technologies to enhance business efficiency. Ensure high availability and optimal performance of applications, implementing advanced security protocols to protect sensitive data, minimize downtime, and maintain a zero-breach security record. Define and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for assigned applications' performance and security to maintain high standards and drive continuous improvement. Oversee departmental performance, develop KPIs, and provide regular feedback, training, and guidance to staff to enhance efficiency and employee development. Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and policies, and develop service level agreements to ensure standardized operations and high service quality within the department. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in managing corporate applications. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage teams effectively. Strong understanding of HR, finance, and procurement application landscapes. Proven experience in project management, including risk mitigation and quality assurance. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position with a work schedule of 5 days a week, including 2 days off. Working hours are from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, with a one-hour break. The role is based entirely indoors.

08b6d26c1fcbe3e4.job_title: Hostess InterContinental The Red Sea Resort
08b6d26c1fcbe3e4.description: About the Role IHG Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Hostess for the InterContinental The Red Sea Resort. This full-time position is based in Umluj, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. The Hostess is responsible for creating a welcoming first impression for guests by providing professional, courteous, and personalized service, ensuring every guest experience reflects the luxury service standards of InterContinental Hotels & Resorts and IHG. Key Responsibilities Warmly and professionally welcome and greet all guests upon arrival, using the restaurant and guest names when possible. Ensure the restaurant entrance, hostess station, tables, and surrounding areas are clean, organized, and prepared before opening. Verify guest reservations and booking details in the reservation system or book. Manage restaurant reservations, including telephone bookings, walk-ins, special requests, and guest dining preferences. Escort guests to their assigned or preferred tables and present menus according to service standards. Coordinate guest seating arrangements and table allocation with the restaurant service team to ensure smooth operations. Provide accurate waiting times and manage guest flow during busy periods. Maintain detailed knowledge of the restaurant menu, beverages, daily specials, promotions, and hotel facilities. Respond promptly and courteously to guest inquiries, requests, and complaints, ensuring appropriate follow-up. Recognize VIP guests, repeat guests, and special occasions to provide personalized service. Coordinate with the Restaurant Manager, service team, and Culinary team to communicate guest preferences and dietary requirements. Maintain the cleanliness and proper presentation of menus, beverage lists, and the hostess station. Assist with food and beverage service when required to support restaurant operations. Maintain accurate guest reservation records and update guest information in the designated system. Promote restaurant offerings and special promotions to enhance the guest experience. Operational Standards and Compliance Maintain professional grooming, personal hygiene, and uniform standards in accordance with IHG policies. Attend departmental briefings, meetings, and training sessions as required. Follow all hotel policies, procedures, brand standards, and applicable food safety and hygiene requirements. Demonstrate awareness of occupational health and safety procedures, fire and emergency protocols, and security requirements. Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by the Restaurant Manager or Food & Beverage Management. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of experience in a similar role. Ability to provide professional, courteous, and personalized service. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Work Environment This role operates within the luxury hospitality environment of the InterContinental The Red Sea Resort, located in Umluj, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. The position is full-time and requires adherence to high service standards.

0873a558f67cd3ea.description: About the Role Aroma City Group is seeking a Senior Civil Engineer to join their team. This full-time position involves overseeing civil engineering and construction activities for large-scale mixed-use developments. The role requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in the field, offering a salary of up to 18,000 SAR. Key Responsibilities Oversee civil engineering and construction activities for large-scale mixed-use developments, ensuring projects meet approved designs, technical specifications, quality standards, and schedules. Supervise site execution, coordinate with contractors and subcontractors, and resolve technical and construction-related challenges across structural and civil works. Review engineering drawings, shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, and technical documentation to ensure project requirements are met. Coordinate with architectural, structural, MEP, and infrastructure teams to ensure seamless integration of multidisciplinary construction activities. Monitor construction progress, identify potential delays and technical risks, and recommend corrective actions to maintain project milestones. Conduct site inspections, oversee quality control activities, and coordinate with consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Provide technical guidance to engineering teams and contribute to the successful execution of high-rise buildings, hospitals, commercial, residential, and hospitality developments. Required Experience Candidates must possess over 10 years of experience in civil engineering and construction, specifically within large-scale mixed-use developments. This experience should include a strong background in supervising site execution and managing various project stakeholders. Technical Skills The ideal candidate will have demonstrated proficiency in reviewing engineering documentation, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, and monitoring project progress. Strong technical acumen in structural and civil works is essential for resolving construction-related challenges. Project Scope This role involves working on a diverse portfolio of projects, including high-rise buildings, hospitals, commercial, residential, and hospitality developments. The Senior Civil Engineer will play a crucial role in ensuring the successful delivery of these complex projects. Compensation The salary offered for this full-time position is up to 18,000 SAR, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

0873a9181acd639d.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our team for an upcoming full-time opportunity in Saudi Arabia. This role focuses on mechanical engineering expertise, particularly within Shutdown / Turnaround (SD/TA) projects. The position is based in the Eastern Region, covering cities such as Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al Jubail, Al-Ahsa, Al Qatif, Buqayq, and Ras Tannurah. Key Responsibilities Lead and execute mechanical maintenance activities during Shutdown / Turnaround projects. Oversee the planning, execution, and coordination of shutdown activities. Manage and maintain various mechanical static equipment, including heat exchangers, columns, pressure vessels, reactors, and pipelines. Utilize Primavera P6 for project scheduling and management. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering. Minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in Mechanical Maintenance or Shutdown / Turnaround projects. Mandatory experience in Shutdown / Turnaround (SD/TA) projects, preferably gained with a contractor. Strong experience with mechanical static equipment, specifically: Heat Exchangers Columns Pressure Vessels Reactors Pipelines Proficiency in Primavera P6 is required. Good English communication skills are essential. Application Requirements Candidates must clearly detail their relevant experience in their CV, supported by verifiable experience certificates or letters. Only applicants with genuine and verifiable Shutdown / Turnaround experience will be considered for this position. Compensation The salary for this full-time role ranges from SAR 4,000 to SAR 7,000 Basic, plus FAT.

08e8a71a2fbd0b4b.description: About the Role Egis is seeking a Senior Document Controller to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing the management, control, and distribution of critical documentation, ensuring compliance with organizational standards and regulatory requirements. The Senior Document Controller will lead document control initiatives, mentor team members, and implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Manage and maintain comprehensive document control systems, including version control, document tracking, and archival procedures. Ensure all documentation complies with organizational policies, industry standards, and applicable Saudi Arabian regulatory requirements. Supervise and coordinate document control team members, providing guidance, training, and performance feedback. Develop and implement standardized document management procedures and best practices to improve efficiency and accuracy. Conduct regular audits of documentation systems to verify compliance and identify areas for process improvement. Collaborate with cross-functional departments to establish document requirements, standards, and distribution protocols. Maintain accurate records of document revisions, approvals, and access logs. Analyze document control metrics and prepare reports to support management decision-making. Serve as a subject matter expert on document control procedures and regulatory compliance matters. Customize and optimize document management software and systems to meet organizational needs. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12 years of experience in document control or a related field. Demonstrated experience in managing comprehensive document control systems. Proven ability to ensure compliance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements. Experience in supervising and mentoring team members. Skills and Attributes Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills. Proficiency in document management software and systems. Strong analytical skills for preparing reports and supporting decision-making. Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional departments. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a team to manage critical documentation and implement process improvements across the organization. Application Process Qualified candidates are invited to apply for this position. The salary for this role will be discussed during the interview process.

087040c74da33224.description: About IBM Consulting IBM Consulting focuses on building long-term client relationships and fostering global collaboration. The firm works with companies across various industries, assisting them in their hybrid cloud and AI initiatives. Supported by strategic partners, IBM technology, and Red Hat, consultants are equipped to drive change and accelerate client impact. The culture at IBM Consulting encourages challenging norms, exploring new ideas, and developing innovative solutions, while also supporting long-term career development. Role Overview IBM is seeking a Security Consultant specializing in Identity & Access Management (IAM) services. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The consultant will assist organizations in understanding and managing the entire identity lifecycle within their enterprise, utilizing commercially available IAM tools to provide Single Sign-On (SSO) and manage user identities effectively. Key Responsibilities Design secure and streamlined identity management systems for organizations using IAM tools such as ISIM/ISAM, Cloud Identity/Okta/Sailpoint/MS Entra. Develop scripts to automate the provisioning and migration of identities across Cloud, OT, IOT, and enterprise IT environments. Utilize directory services like TDI and AD, and protocols such as SAML and OAuth for identity automation. Implement Single Sign-On (SSO) solutions using commercially available IAM tools to manage user identities. Support organizations in managing the complete identity lifecycle within their enterprise, ensuring secure and efficient identity management practices. Optimize identity management systems and ensure seamless integration with existing infrastructure through hands-on experience with SAML, OAuth, and scripting. Required Qualifications and Experience Experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM) services. Proficiency with commercially available IAM tools for Single Sign-On (SSO) and user identity management. Demonstrated experience with IAM tools such as ISIM/ISAM, Cloud Identity/Okta/Sailpoint/MS Entra. Ability to develop automation scripts for identity provisioning and migration. Familiarity with directory services including TDI and AD, and protocols like SAML and OAuth. A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The salary for this role will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

08fcdec0072ce0c9.description: About Carrier Carrier is a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, dedicated to developing innovations that enhance comfort, safety, and sustainability in buildings and communities. The company is committed to delivering reliable, high-quality HVAC and mechanical solutions to its customers. The Role of Senior Project Engineer As a Senior Project Engineer - Saudi National, you will manage and support HVAC and mechanical replacement projects. This full-time role involves overseeing projects from initial site assessment and RFQ preparation through procurement, execution, testing and commissioning, and final handover. The position requires 8-10 years of experience and focuses on ensuring accurate technical assessments, complete project scopes, and effective coordination with stakeholders to mitigate execution risks and deliver projects according to technical requirements, schedules, budgets, and quality standards. Key Responsibilities Conduct site surveys for HVAC and mechanical replacement projects, verifying existing conditions, identifying technical requirements, and defining the scope of work. Prepare comprehensive Requests for Quotation (RFQs), including scope of work, Bill of Quantities (BOQs), technical requirements, drawings, and relevant site information. Coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors to obtain and evaluate technically compliant and commercially competitive quotations. Manage assigned projects throughout the project lifecycle, from initial site assessment and procurement to execution, testing and commissioning, snag clearance, and final handover. Review technical submittals, quotations, equipment and material selections, method statements, and subcontractor proposals to ensure compliance with project specifications. Coordinate with clients, consultants, suppliers, subcontractors, and internal teams to resolve technical challenges and site-related issues. Monitor project schedules, costs, quality, safety, material deliveries, and site progress, identifying potential delays, execution risks, and commercial impacts. Prepare project progress reports, variation requests, and supporting technical documentation to maintain effective project control. Ensure project activities comply with applicable technical standards, contractual requirements, company procedures, and health and safety requirements. Coordinate testing and commissioning, resolve outstanding snags, and ensure the timely completion of project handover documentation. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 8-10 years of experience in project engineering or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage HVAC and mechanical replacement projects. Strong technical assessment and coordination skills. Proficiency in preparing RFQs, BOQs, and technical documentation. Ability to monitor project schedules, costs, and quality effectively. Commitment to Quality and Safety The Senior Project Engineer is responsible for upholding technical standards, contractual requirements, company procedures, and health and safety regulations throughout all project activities. This includes ensuring all project phases, from initial assessment to final handover, meet established quality and safety benchmarks.

08bd558311c902f8.description: About the Role Jotun is seeking a Document Controller to join their team in Dammam. This full-time position is responsible for managing all documentation related to the receiving, storing, labeling, picking, loading, and delivery of Raw Materials and Finished Goods. The role ensures compliance with HSEQ (Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality) requirements and service targets, reporting directly to the Warehouse Manager. Key Responsibilities Efficiently process signed delivery notes from transport companies, track all deliveries, and ensure all invoices are received. Record and scan delivery notes, making them available in the system and for respective area sales representatives. Ensure correct forms, information, and approvals are provided before processing return materials. Issue return and credit notes in the system once items are back in the warehouse and send credit notes to sales. Verify that returned materials due to defect, transportation damage, or loading errors are returned to the warehouse and replaced with correct stock. Send daily reports to track leased Dyna vehicles and their usage percentage. Prepare shortage lists and blocked order lists for sharing with the direct manager. Receive and verify transport company invoices against delivery records and waybills for accuracy before submission. Support warehouse managers and the team with pallet tracking and daily warehouse operations. Coordinate with administration for purchase inquiries. Candidate Requirements Experience required: 1-3 year. Ability to act on own initiative, drive tasks forward, and accept responsibility for results. Understanding of organizational informal rules and structures, with effective utilization of political processes to achieve objectives. A methodical and systematic approach to planning, defining clear priorities, and allocating resources effectively. Capacity to quickly understand and analyze complex issues and problems, making sound and rational judgments. Demonstrated specialist knowledge and expertise within their area, with a commitment to continuous professional development. Strong cooperation skills, including sharing knowledge, experience, and information, and supporting team goals. Work Location This position is based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Jotun invites qualified candidates to apply for this Document Controller role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

08de131148d4dbba.description: About Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. is a key delivery partner for one of Saudi Arabia’s flagship giga projects, central to Vision 2030. This landmark development, located approximately 45 km southwest of Riyadh, aims to diversify the economy and enhance quality of life through world-class attractions, residential communities, and natural landscapes, while generating significant employment and enabling long-term, sustainable growth. Role Overview Jacobs is seeking a Senior Project Controls Manager for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, covering all SA Regions. This role involves leading and coordinating the project controls function across a major program of works, ensuring the effective integration of schedule management, reporting, risk, information management, change control, and interface management throughout the project lifecycle. The Senior Manager will provide leadership and technical guidance to the project controls team, ensuring project information is accurate, consistent, and transparent to enable informed decision-making and effective project delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate the project controls function, integrating schedule, reporting, risk, information management, change control, and interface management activities across the project lifecycle. Prepare, maintain, and review internal project schedules, ensuring alignment with program governance, reporting requirements, contractual obligations, and established project controls standards. Review contractor baseline schedules and periodic updates, identify discrepancies and emerging issues, and coordinate schedule review outcomes with internal teams and contractors. Develop and maintain progress measurement, forecasting, performance reporting, and schedule management tools. Review contractor daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, ensuring submissions are accurate, appropriately justified, and completed in accordance with the reporting calendar. Coordinate with project delivery, commercial, procurement, design, engineering, construction, and other cross-functional teams to obtain, validate, and consolidate project information. Prepare and maintain project risk registers, facilitate risk workshops, monitor mitigation actions, and undertake performance analysis. Oversee project information and document control processes, including workflow registers, document version control, multi-stakeholder reviews, and the maintenance of accurate historical records within SharePoint. Establish and manage project change control processes, ensuring changes are effectively recorded, assessed, tracked, communicated, and integrated into project schedules and reporting. Develop and maintain project and asset interface registers, working with relevant stakeholders to monitor dependencies and resolve interface issues. Provide advice, reporting, presentations, and project controls insights to senior leadership. Lead, coach, and develop the project controls team, promoting accountability, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in project controls. Strong leadership capability, with experience setting clear objectives, prioritizing team workloads, developing colleagues, and delivering results against demanding deadlines. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect project information, identify emerging issues, and drive timely and practical responses. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly present project performance, risks, strategies, and recommendations to various audiences. Previous experience within Saudi Arabia, the wider Middle East, major developments, or complex multi-stakeholder programs is preferred. Work Environment The Senior Project Controls Manager will work closely with project leadership, delivery teams, contractors, consultants, and cross-functional stakeholders to monitor performance, identify emerging risks, and support project delivery safely, on time, within budget, and to required quality standards. The position also drives continual improvement of project controls systems, processes, and reporting standards.

08efa9889663382c.company_name: Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts, Saudi Arabia
08efa9889663382c.description: About the Opportunity Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts, Saudi Arabia, is seeking a Carpenter to join the pre-opening team at the Four Seasons Resort and Residences Red Sea. This full-time position is based in Umluj and Al Wajh, Saudi Arabia, and involves contributing to a pioneering luxury destination on Saudi Arabia’s west coast. Role Overview The Carpenter will be responsible for executing high-quality carpentry work across the property. This role ensures that all woodwork, furnishings, fixtures, and decorative elements consistently meet Four Seasons' established standards of quality and maintenance. Key Responsibilities Perform routine and preventive maintenance on woodwork in guest rooms, public areas, offices, and back-of-house spaces. Construct, repair, and refurbish furniture, doors, windows, cabinetry, and decorative wood features. Assist with the installation and adjustment of fixtures, paneling, and signage throughout the property. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment, ensuring all tools are in good condition. Collaborate with the Engineering, Housekeeping, and other departments to address repair requests and support project needs. Maintain accurate records of all completed work and materials utilized. Adhere to all safety protocols and consistently wear required personal protective equipment (PPE). Support sustainability initiatives by actively minimizing waste and recycling materials where feasible. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in carpentry or a related field. Demonstrated ability to perform high-quality carpentry work. Familiarity with safety protocols and the use of personal protective equipment. Work Schedule This is a full-time position requiring rotating shifts, which will include weekends and holidays. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. Salary information for this role is not disclosed.

086b6e0c4df16c9c.description: About the Role Mohammad Mansour Al Rumaih Company for Trading is seeking a Data Center Whitespace IT Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing and maintaining all IT-related infrastructure within the data center’s white space, including servers, racks, structured cabling, and power distribution for IT equipment. The engineer will supervise whitespace electrical and network technicians, ensuring optimal performance, uptime, and compliance with operational standards, and will work closely with the Facility Manager to support critical IT operations and infrastructure reliability. Key Responsibilities Oversee the installation, operation, and maintenance of IT racks, servers, and structured cabling. Ensure proper power distribution to IT equipment, including PDUs and rack-level electrical systems. Monitor network connectivity and troubleshoot LAN issues within the white space. Lead and supervise whitespace electrical and network technicians in daily operations and maintenance tasks. Assign work orders, monitor progress, and ensure adherence to safety and operational protocols. Provide technical guidance and training to technicians. Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules for IT racks, cabling, and power systems. Respond to IT infrastructure faults and coordinate corrective actions promptly. Ensure compliance with data center standards (TIA-942, ASHRAE) and company policies. Maintain proper labeling and documentation for cabling and rack layouts. Prepare detailed reports on IT infrastructure performance, incidents, and maintenance activities. Maintain accurate documentation of rack layouts, cabling diagrams, and power distribution. Provide monthly and quarterly reports to the Facility Manager on white space infrastructure status and improvement plans. Assist in IT infrastructure design and commissioning for data center expansions or upgrades. Coordinate with vendors for equipment procurement and installation. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 3-5 years of experience in a relevant field, demonstrating a solid understanding of data center IT infrastructure and operations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring on-site presence within the data center environment. The role involves working collaboratively with facility management and technical teams to ensure continuous operational excellence.

087b29ae336dca13.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اعالي الطموح للخدمات اللوجستية عن أخصائي إدارة أداء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتحليل ممارسات إدارة الأداء، وتنسيق عمليات التقييم، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة لدعم الأهداف المؤسسية. المهام الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل التجارب والممارسات الدولية في إدارة الأداء، وتقييم جدوى تطبيقها، وتقديم التوصيات لتبني أفضل الأساليب الحديثة. تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للأداء بما يتماشى مع السياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة لضمان تحقيق أفضل نتائج العمل الممكنة. تنسيق عملية تقييم أداء الموظفين، وتقديم الدعم للوحدات التنظيمية، والرد على الاستفسارات لضمان تنفيذ عمليات التقييم ضمن الأوقات المحددة. جمع وتحليل نتائج تقييم الأداء، وإعداد التقارير ذات الصلة، ورفعها للإدارة للمراجعة والاعتماد. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بإدارة الأداء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل الممارسات الدولية وتكييفها. مهارات قوية في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة اعالي الطموح للخدمات اللوجستية في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. تتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بالعمل ضمن الأوقات الزمنية المحددة لعمليات تقييم الأداء. نطاق المسؤولية يتولى أخصائي إدارة الأداء مسؤولية شاملة عن تحليل وتطوير وتنسيق عمليات إدارة الأداء المؤسسي، مع التركيز على الدقة في جمع البيانات وإعداد التقارير لدعم اتخاذ القرارات الإدارية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في مؤسسة اعالي الطموح للخدمات اللوجستية.

08b1d76f478fa1ec.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة ابراهيم محمد الوهيبي للتجارة والمقاولات العامة عن مشرف إنشاء طرق للانضمام إلى فريقها في عنيزة، القصيم. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على تنفيذ مشاريع إنشاء الطرق، والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية والبرامج الزمنية المحددة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل التفصيلي لمشاريع إنشاء الطرق بالتنسيق مع مهندس الطرق المشرف. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال إنشاء الطرق لضمان الالتزام بالمواصفات الفنية والبرامج التنفيذية المعتمدة. أخذ عينات عشوائية من مواد إنشاء الطرق، مثل الخلطات الإسفلتية، وإرسالها إلى المختبر للفحص والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات. قياس الأعمال المنجزة في الموقع بالتنسيق المباشر مع مهندس الطرق المشرف. تقدير كميات المواد وحجم العمالة اللازمة لكل مرحلة من مراحل المشروع. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيق جميع الإجراءات والنتائج وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إنشاء الطرق أو الإشراف عليها. القدرة على دراسة المخططات الهندسية للطرق ووثائق المناقصات. معرفة جيدة بمواصفات مواد إنشاء الطرق وإجراءات فحص الجودة. مهارات في إعداد التقارير الفنية وتوثيق الأعمال. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في عنيزة، القصيم. سيعمل مشرف إنشاء الطرق ضمن فريق متخصص، وسيكون مسؤولاً عن الإشراف المباشر على مواقع العمل لضمان سير المشاريع بكفاءة ووفقاً للمعايير المطلوبة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل المنطقة: القصيم المدينة: عنيزة الراتب: غير معلن

08b506df2e738b85.description: About the Role Noble Horizon is seeking a Head of Vehicles to lead the overall strategy, growth, and operations of its vehicles department. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on generating new business leads, developing the existing client network for commercial and residential high-end projects, and driving revenue and profit growth. The role involves proactive management of relationships with both existing and prospective clients. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement strategic plans for the vehicles department, aligning with company goals. Formulate proposals and strategies for new opportunities, including budgeting, scheduling, and operational activities. Monitor sales and market data to inform sales and social media strategies, and prepare design and build contracts. Ensure social media content complies with relevant standards and follows trends in the vehicles market, social media, and website technology. Manage the vehicles department staff, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation. Prepare and present financial and sales reports to senior management. Develop and maintain relationships with external stakeholders such as government officials, community organizations, and real estate professionals. Consult clients on market conditions, pricing, financing, legal requirements, and other vehicle sales-related matters. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 7 years of experience in the automotive industry, specifically in vehicle sales, dealership management, automotive trading, or fleet sales. At least 3 years in a senior sales leadership, department management, or general management role with responsibility for revenue growth and business development. Proven track record in developing and executing sales strategies, generating new business, expanding client networks, and achieving sales and profitability targets. Strong experience managing high-value vehicle sales, commercial partnerships, corporate accounts, and relationships with individual and institutional clients. Demonstrated ability to analyze automotive market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and sales performance to identify growth opportunities. Experience managing departmental budgets, sales forecasts, financial reporting, and operational performance, with a focus on revenue growth and cost efficiency. Proficiency in digital sales channels, social media marketing, online vehicle listings, and website-based sales platforms. Required Skills Proven leadership skills, including team management, recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and cross-functional collaboration. Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills to build and maintain connections with customers, suppliers, dealerships, corporate clients, and external stakeholders. Good understanding of vehicle pricing, financing options, sales processes, and applicable automotive regulations and legal requirements in Saudi Arabia. Strong commercial judgment, analytical skills, and a results-oriented mindset, with the ability to translate business strategies into measurable sales and profitability outcomes. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring 5-10 years of relevant experience. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join Noble Horizon and contribute to the growth of its vehicles department.

08b6d6d8a7c87f60.description: About Tamara Tamara is a prominent shopping and payments platform operating in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region. The company aims to enhance how individuals shop, pay, and bank. Founded by Abdulmajeed Alsukhan, Turki Bin Zarah, and Abdulmohsen Al Babtain, Tamara is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with additional offices in the UAE, Egypt, Germany, and Vietnam. The platform serves millions of users and collaborates with thousands of merchants, including both global and regional brands, as well as local small and medium businesses. Tamara is supported by investors such as SNB Capital, Sanabil Investments, *********, Coatue, Shorooq Partners, and Endeavor Catalyst. Role Overview Tamara is seeking a Compliance Senior Associate to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the Compliance Department in ensuring adherence to SAMA regulations applicable to payment services, including activities under the Electronic Money Institution (EMI) license and other Payment Service Provider (PSP) categories. The position encompasses both advisory and monitoring responsibilities to maintain ongoing regulatory compliance. Key Responsibilities Ensure compliance with all applicable SAMA regulations related to payment services, such as EMI, PSP, and wallet providers. Review and approve new products to ensure alignment with SAMA requirements. Monitor internal processes and product structures for regulatory adherence. Track, interpret, and implement changes from SAMA circulars and regulatory updates. Review and maintain internal policies and procedures to ensure consistency with current SAMA regulations. Ensure proper dissemination of all circulars and publications issued by SAMA and follow up with relevant departments for timely implementation. Prepare and submit accurate regulatory reports to SAMA within required timelines. Review management reports submitted to SAMA for accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with internal teams to collect and validate data required by SAMA. Support regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation actions as needed. Provide advisory support to internal stakeholders on payment-related compliance matters. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a compliance role within a SAMA-regulated entity operating in the payments sector. Solid understanding of SAMA’s regulatory framework for payment services. Experience in regulatory reporting and policy review. Required Skills Strong communication, coordination, and analytical skills. Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. A driven, determined, and curious team player with a positive, solution-oriented outlook. Ability to work effectively with others through empathy and respect, responding quickly and adapting to changes without losing momentum. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

08e85647ef38af99.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سي بي في العربية عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، حيث يركز على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التشغيل والصيانة. الغرض من الوظيفة يهدف هذا الدور إلى المساهمة في إعداد التصاميم الهندسية الميكانيكية، وتطوير برامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات والمعدات الصناعية، بالإضافة إلى وضع خطط الصيانة الوقائية لضمان كفاءة العمليات التشغيلية في المشاريع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية. فهم جيد لبرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. معرفة ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات الصناعية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي بدوام كامل في مقر الشركة بالرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على تنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية الميكانيكية. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الميكانيكيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في شركة سي بي في العربية.

08166e2fdfcacced.description: Job description Overview KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end-to-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities. As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. We invite you to join us. Why? When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company-wide health and well-being through on-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards. Responsibilities Our newest opportunity is for a talented Senior Structural Engineer (Civil) to join our award winning team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Extensive experience in Design Review Methodology, including preparation of review schedules, review workflows, and design assurance processes. Proven ability to perform Design Compliance Reviews against project requirements, applicable codes, standards, regulations, and employer requirements. Strong knowledge of Value Engineering (VE) and Constructability Reviews, with the ability to identify cost, quality, operational, and construction optimization opportunities. Experience in developing and managing Comment Resolution Registers. Ability to provide recommendations for design stage approvals and IFC (Issued for Construction) submissions. Good understanding of BIM Coordination, Clash Detection, and review of BIM Coordination Reports (preferred). 0840d89c646e0baf.description: Nabeh, a subsidiary of Master Works, delivers AI-powered solutions that help organizations automate operations, boost efficiency, and drive innovation. Its expertise spans computer vision, LLM applications, speech-to-text, data intelligence, and low-code AI solutions. Nabeh is looking for an AI Project Manager, Senior to lead the end-to-end delivery of AI, computer vision, Generative AI (GenAI), and intelligent-platform projects. The role is responsible for translating contractual commitments into secure, technically feasible, and measurable client outcomes while managing project scope, schedules, budgets, quality, risks, and formal acceptance. The Senior AI Project Manager will serve as the primary coordination point between clients, AI and engineering teams, infrastructure, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery and alignment with business objectives. Key Responsibilities Lead project initiation and handover from Sales, reviewing contracts, statements of work (SOWs), purchase orders (POs), deliverables, commercial milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. Develop and maintain integrated project management plans, detailed schedules, milestones, forecasts, and approved project baselines, ensuring changes are documented and formally approved. Manage project kickoffs, stakeholder communication, risk and issue tracking, change requests, status reporting, steering committees, and escalation processes. Maintain accurate project documentation, contracts, approvals, deliverables, and correspondence, ensuring records are organized and audit-ready. Coordinate the end-to-end AI delivery lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, data preparation, model development or configuration, integration, deployment, user acceptance testing (UAT), go-live, and hyper care. Track AI model performance requirements and success measures, including precision, recall, false positives, inference latency, operational monitoring, and retraining requirements, where applicable. Monitor readiness of datasets, development environments, GPUs, edge devices, camera streams, APIs, cloud or on-premises infrastructure, cybersecurity reviews, licenses, and third-party integrations. Coordinate technical validation, security and privacy approvals, client UAT, production readiness, user training, handover, and service transition, ensuring the required evidence and technical sign-offs are obtained. Coordinate AI engineers, technical leads, DevOps, infrastructure, business analysts, QA, UI/UX, support, field teams, and subcontractors to align responsibilities, priorities, dependencies, and delivery commitments. Monitor project progress, identify blockers and resource constraints, and coordinate recovery plans and escalations through PMO and functional leadership. Coordinate site readiness, permits, logistics, safety requirements, and vendor mobilization for field and edge AI deployments. Track project budgets, resource utilization, timesheets, vendor purchase orders, cost-to-complete, financial milestones, invoicing requirements, and potential margin exposure. Coordinate signed acceptance documents, completion certificates (CoCs), and supporting evidence required for timely invoicing and payment. Manage subcontractor deliverables, schedules, dependencies, and handovers, coordinating contractual and commercial changes with Sales, Finance, Procurement, and Legal. Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact for project delivery, communicating progress, issues, corrective actions, and decisions clearly and proactively in English and Arabic as required. Coordinate quality assurance activities, defect prioritization, UAT plans, issue resolution, user training, operational documentation, support service-level agreements (SLAs), and formal client acceptance. Lead project closure activities, including documentation handover, lessons learned, financial reconciliation, and transition to support or managed services. Prepare regular project status reports highlighting milestones, risks, budget status, delivery progress, outstanding actions, and issues requiring management attention. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of project delivery experience, including at least 2 years managing AI, analytics, computer vision, software/platform, or complex integration projects. Strong knowledge of project management practices aligned with PMI principles, including scope, schedule, risk, stakeholder, procurement, cost, quality, and change control. Experience managing Agile or hybrid project delivery methodologies. Practical understanding of AI/ML delivery lifecycles and the technical dependencies involved in data, integrations, infrastructure, model validation, and production readiness. Experience working with enterprise clients, vendors, statements of work (SOWs), purchase orders (POs), project budgets, invoicing milestones, and formal acceptance processes. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; professional Arabic is highly desirable for client-facing project delivery in Saudi Arabia. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and project management tools such as MS Project and Jira. Strong leadership, organizational, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities, project risks, deadlines, and cross-functional dependencies effectively. Ability to maintain accurate project documentation and handle confidential business and client information professionally. Willingness to work onsite with clients and travel within Saudi Arabia as project requirements dictate. Preferred Qualifications PMP or an equivalent project management certification. AI project management training or certification, such as CPMAI. Experience in smart cities, video analytics/CCTV, edge AI, Generative AI, cloud or on-premises deployments, or government-sector programs. Exposure to Saudi client environments, site and traffic-safety governance, data protection, and cybersecurity processes. Experience using enterprise project and resource management systems.

المباشر على أعضاء فريق التشغيل والصيانة ومتابعة تنفيذ المهام اليومية. توزيع الأعمال والمهام على أفراد الفريق بناءً على الأولويات واحتياجات الموقع. متابعة أعمال التشغيل والصيانة لضمان إنجازها في الوقت إجراء الجولات الميدانية ومتابعة حالة المرافق والمعدات ضمن نطاق المسؤولية. التأكد من التزام أفراد الفريق بتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية. متابعة الالتزام بأوقات العمل والحضور والانصراف ورفع أي ملاحظات للجهة المختصة. التنسيق مع فرق التشغيل والصيانة الأخرى عند الحاجة لضمان استمرارية العمل. متابعة استخدام الأدوات والمعدات ومواد الصيانة والمحافظة عليها. التأكد من المحافظة على مرافق الموقع وممتلكاته. إعداد ورفع التقارير اليومية أو الدورية عن الأعمال المنجزة والملاحظات والأعطال. الإبلاغ الفوري عن الحالات الطارئة أو الأعطال التي قد تؤثر على استمرارية التشغيل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الشركة والتعليمات المعتمدة بالموقع. تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى ذات علاقة يتم تكليفه بها من المسؤول المباشر. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التشغيل والصيانة. القدرة على الإشراف 0825eace8dbf85f5.description: About the Role IHG Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Sales Manager for a full-time position in Riyadh, Riyadh. This role is responsible for developing and implementing sales and marketing strategies for the hotel to achieve positive goal attainment. The Sales Manager will focus on selling hotel rooms, meeting spaces, and food and beverage services through direct client contact. Key Responsibilities Manage daily activities, plan, and assign tasks to ensure adequate staffing within the sales team. Support the sales team through training and feedback to improve performance and set individual development goals. 083f39262f0f379c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني صيانة أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشخيص وإصلاح وصيانة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية لضمان كفاءتها التشغيلية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الإلكترونية للمنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية بدقة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة اللازمة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية وفقاً للخطط المحددة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في صيانة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الإلكترونية وتحديد أسبابها. معرفة جيدة ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية وإجراءات تنفيذها. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق متخصص في صيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالدقة والجودة في جميع مهام الصيانة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

08466bd0336eeb62.description: About the Role Petrocon Engineers & Consultants is seeking a DCS SCADA & Automation Commissioning Engineer to join their team in Al Wajh, Tabuk. The role requires a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, with a strong emphasis on immediate availability. Conduct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), loop checks, functional testing, and troubleshooting. 08539bf5eb9d8746.description: About the Role Front End Limited Company is seeking a Business Development Manager — Offshore to lead the expansion of its offshore energy portfolio in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in the Eastern Province, covering Al Khobar and Dhahran. The primary focus of this role is to secure scopes within Saudi Aramco's Offshore Maintain Potential Program (MPP), with a secondary focus on offshore and marine programs from the Ministry of Transport and Logistic Services and Mawani. The successful candidate will manage the complete business development cycle, from market intelligence and client engagement to opportunity qualification, proposal leadership, commercial negotiation, and contract handover. This involves converting Front End's exclusive partnerships, particularly with Acteon, into pre-qualifications, Long Term Agreements (LTAs), and awarded projects. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a capture plan for Aramco's Offshore MPP work scopes, including platform tie-ins, jackets and decks, MOPU installations, subsea pipeline replacements, brownfield modifications, and platform life-extension campaigns. Map MPP stakeholders across Aramco's Offshore Projects Department, Northern Area Oil Operations (NAOO), Upstream Engineering Services, Marine Department, and Procurement & Supply Chain Management (P&SCM), building relationships at decision-making levels. Track MPP package releases, EPCI tender cycles, and IKTVA expectations, positioning Front End and alliance partners for prequalification (9COM, SAP Ariba), technical evaluation, and award. Lead pursuit strategies for Long Term Agreements (LTAs) and call-off scopes under Aramco's offshore framework contracts for services such as survey, positioning, mooring, foundations, inspection, IRM, and decommissioning. Drive business development for Mawani-led offshore and nearshore programs, including port expansions, marine infrastructure upgrades, dredging support, hydrographic and geophysical surveys, mooring systems, quay-wall and breakwater works, and offshore aids-to-navigation. Engage the Ministry of Transport and Logistic Services on national maritime initiatives aligned with the National Transport and Logistics Strategy (NTLS) and Saudi Vision 2030. Pursue framework agreements, LTAs, and project-specific tenders issued by Mawani and its operating partners. Manage the offshore opportunity pipeline in CRM, forecasting bookings, revenue, and gross margin by program. Lead bid strategy, win themes, pricing posture, and risk allocation in collaboration with Operations, Engineering, Finance, and Legal teams. Oversee proposal development with Front End's proposals team and alliance partners to ensure compliant and competitive submissions. Negotiate LTAs, master service agreements, and call-off contracts, ensuring smooth handover to Project Delivery. Maintain a structured view of Saudi Arabia's offshore market, including Aramco offshore CAPEX/OPEX, Mawani port master plan, and Red Sea/NEOM coastal developments. Monitor competitor activity and integrate insights into positioning and pricing strategy. Identify opportunities for new alliances, technology transfer, and localization to enhance IKTVA scores. Act as Front End's primary commercial interface with offshore alliance partners, coordinating joint pursuits, technical workshops, and client visits. Represent Front End at industry events such as ADIPEC, Saudi Maritime Congress, Aramco supplier forums, and Mawani industry days. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Petroleum, Marine, Civil/Structural, or Subsea), Geoscience, or a related technical discipline. An MBA is an advantage. 8–12 years of business development or commercial experience in the offshore oil & gas or marine sector, with at least 4 years of sales experience in Saudi Arabia. Demonstrated success in closing offshore scopes with Saudi Aramco and/or Mawani / MoT, evidenced by named awards, LTAs, or framework agreements. Strong working knowledge of Aramco's prequalification process (9COM, SAP Ariba, IKTVA), contracting strategies, and offshore technical standards (SAES, SAEP, SAMSS). Familiarity with Mawani tendering and Ministry of Transport procurement processes. Hands-on experience leading complex offshore proposals (EPCI, IRM, survey, mooring, foundations, decommissioning) typically above USD 10 million. Commercial acumen across pricing, contract terms (FIDIC, LOGIC, bespoke Aramco/Mawani forms), risk allocation, and consortium structuring. Preferred Qualifications Candidates with direct familiarity with Saudi Aramco Long Term Agreements (LTAs) and the Offshore Maintain Potential Program will receive higher consideration. This includes evidence of: Previous business development or account-management ownership of an Aramco offshore LTA (survey, mooring, foundations, IRM, or marine construction support), including call-off generation, scope expansion, and renewal. Direct involvement in Maintain Potential Program offshore campaigns such as tie-ins, MOPU/jacket installations, brownfield modifications, pipeline replacements, or platform life-extension work. An established network within Aramco Offshore Projects, NAOO, Marine Department, and the contracting community supporting MPP. A track record of structuring consortium or alliance bids that meet Aramco IKTVA and Saudization requirements. Work Type and Experience This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of relevant experience. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

087740f0305883e9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجمع الدار البيضاء الطبي عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتحسين جودة خدمة العملاء، وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء، والمساهمة في وضع الإجراءات والأدلة لضمان رضا العملاء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. الغرض من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل الوظيفة إلى وضع وتحديد مؤشرات ومعايير الأداء والجودة في خدمة العملاء، والمشاركة في تحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء. كما يشمل الدور تطوير برامج لتعزيز جودة أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نقاط القوة والضعف، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة برضا العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة في خدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة، وضمان المتابعة المستمرة. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية وكفاءة، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تطوير برامج ومبادرات لضمان تجاوز توقعات واحتياجات المتعاملين من حيث جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، بهدف بناء نموذج متكامل. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نتائج تقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع الخطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء ومعايير الجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف وتحليل بيانات رضا العملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل أخصائي خدمة العملاء ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى مستويات الجودة ورضا العملاء. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة في شركة مجمع الدار البيضاء الطبي.
